identity.operation: Parse an OBJ vertex through ParseFromString with config.vertex_color=false.
identity.condition: The vertex has no RGB components and vertex-color fallback is disabled.
identity.capability: Accept the vertex while leaving fallback colors absent.
identity.consequence: The vertex is rejected or fallback colors are supplied.

requirement: With vertex-color fallback disabled, accept an OBJ vertex without RGB components without supplying fallback colors.

assessment.necessity_reason: Parsing an OBJ vertex without RGB while disabling fallback is supported by ParseFromString. A finite OBJ input can trigger it, but the harness always passes a default configuration whose vertex_color value is true. Input bytes cannot change that setting.

before.requirement: Parse a vertex without RGB with config.vertex_color=false, accepting it while leaving fallback colors absent.
before.reason: The old loader accepts an uncolored vertex and clears colors when fallback is disabled. The harness never sets vertex_color=false.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The vertex parser reports missing RGB and supplies white values for fallback.
ParseFromString forwards config.vertex_color to the loader.

after.requirement: Parse a vertex without RGB with config.vertex_color=false, accepting it while leaving fallback colors absent.
after.reason: The changed loader retains the disabled-fallback behavior. The same harness still passes vertex_color=true.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The changed vertex parser identifies a vertex without RGB as three components.
ObjReaderConfig still defaults vertex_color to true.
ParseFromString still forwards config.vertex_color to the loader.

assessment.comparison_reason: On both sides, the fixed harness constructs a default ObjReaderConfig and never changes vertex_color. No OBJ input can select the disabled-fallback path.

necessity_evidence.reason: The same target-coverage obligation is unsatisfied before and after: ParseFromString supports parsing an OBJ vertex without RGB with vertex_color=false and leaving colors empty, but the fixed harness always passes a default configuration with vertex_color=true. The gap is preexisting.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: OBJ text `v 0 0 0\n`, followed by a NUL separator and one MTL byte, for example `x`. With the supported setup vertex_color=false, parsing succeeds with no colors. The harness uses vertex_color=true, so this input receives fallback colors.

scope_contract.reason: Vertex-color fallback is a configuration of the harness's primary ParseFromString operation, and ParseFromString forwards it to the OBJ loader.

evidence.dependency_reason: Declares the vertex_color configuration and its default.
Forwards vertex_color from ParseFromString to LoadObj.

feasible_trigger.reason: A finite uncolored `v` line is accepted by the parser. With vertex_color=false, the loader omits or clears colors. The harness can supply that OBJ text but fixes the configuration at its true default.

evidence.dependency_reason: Classifies a vertex without RGB as three components.

observable_consequence.reason: For an uncolored vertex, false fallback leaves the output colors empty; the harness's true fallback instead pushes RGB fallback values. Thus the supported no-fallback behavior is unreachable.

evidence.dependency_reason: Sets white fallback values when RGB is absent.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete harness constructs one default configuration, never mutates it, and makes one ParseFromString call. Its input bytes change only the OBJ and MTL strings; neither string changes config.vertex_color. An empty OBJ could yield empty colors but does not satisfy the uncolored-vertex condition.

evidence.dependency_reason: Forwards the fixed configuration argument to the loader.
Establishes that the unmodified configuration selects true fallback.

identity_preserved.reason: Both source versions support the same tuple: ParseFromString, an OBJ vertex without RGB, vertex_color=false, and acceptance with colors absent. The same default-configuration blocker applies to the old harness on both sides, establishing preexisting timing.

evidence.dependency_reason: The before configuration defaults vertex_color to true.
The after configuration has the same default.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Before ParseFromString forwards the fallback setting.
After ParseFromString forwards the fallback setting.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Parse an OBJ vertex without RGB with vertex_color=false, accepting it while leaving the colors vector empty.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Construct ObjReaderConfig and set vertex_color=false before calling ParseFromString.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness default-constructs ObjReaderConfig, whose vertex_color is true, and passes it unchanged.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: No uncolored OBJ vertex can be parsed through this target with fallback disabled.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: None: input bytes supply OBJ and MTL text only; the complete harness has no configuration mutation or second call sequence.
